scheduled_tasks_and_queue_setup: Scheduled tasks, queue & server cron setup
cron_setup_guide_intro: This system needs ONE server cron entry. It runs Laravel's scheduler every minute, which fires all scheduled tasks below and processes every queued background job.
cron_setup_step_ssh: SSH into your server and open the crontab editor
cron_setup_step_add_line: Paste the crontab entry below on a new line, save and exit.
cron_setup_step_verify: Wait 1-2 minutes, then press Refresh above — Cron Status should turn Active.
cron_not_running_warning: The server cron is NOT running. Scheduled tasks and background jobs (emails, notifications, referral/cashback credits, bulk imports) will not execute until it is set up. You can run tasks manually below in the meantime.
scheduled_tasks_intro: These run automatically every minute once the cron is set up. You can also run any of them manually right now.
cron_task_schedule_run_desc: Master task — fires everything below that is due (this is what the server cron calls).
cron_task_queue_desc: Drains all pending background jobs: emails, push notifications, referral & cashback credits, bulk imports.
cron_task_cart_notification_desc: Sends abandoned-cart reminder push notifications to customers.
background_jobs_intro: These jobs are queued automatically by app events and executed by "Process Queued Jobs" — they are not run directly.
cron_job_referral_bonus_desc: Credits the referrer's bonus after the order's return period ends (queued on delivery).
cron_job_cashback_desc: Credits order cashback to the customer's wallet after the return period ends.
cron_job_order_emails_desc: Order placed / status update emails to customers and admin.
cron_job_order_notifications_desc: Order status push notifications to customers and delivery boys.
cron_job_bulk_emails_desc: Promotional emails composed in Admin > Emails, sent to many customers in the background.
cron_job_bulk_push_desc: Broadcast push notifications composed in Admin > Notifications, sent in the background.
cron_job_product_bulk_desc: Processes product bulk upload/update files with live progress.
cron_job_cart_reminder_desc: Scheduled reminder cycle for abandoned carts.
cron_guide_ssh_note: The interval (five stars = every minute) is part of the line itself. Save and exit the editor; the cron is installed immediately.
cron_guide_custom_step_open: Open your hosting panel's Cron Jobs section (cPanel, Plesk, hPanel, DirectAdmin, etc.).
cron_guide_custom_step_interval: Set the interval to "Once Per Minute" (choose * for every interval field if asked).
cron_guide_custom_step_paste: Paste the command below into the Command field — do NOT include the five stars; the panel adds the interval itself.
cron_guide_custom_note: If your panel rejects "cd" or "&&", use the PHP Script tab instead — it needs no directory change.
cron_guide_php_step_type: Choose the "PHP" cron type if your panel offers one (some panels ask for a PHP script instead of a shell command).
cron_guide_php_step_fields: Use the full command below, or fill the panel's separate fields with the Script Path and Argument shown.
cron_guide_php_note: If this PHP path doesn't work on your host, ask support for the PHP CLI binary path (often /usr/local/bin/php or ea-php8.3) and replace the first part.

bulk_step_1_desc: The file's columns are generated from this selection: the category decides attribute and custom-field columns, each selected store adds its own pricing & stock columns. Changing the selection means downloading a fresh file.
bulk_step_2_desc_upload: Download the sample — it contains dropdowns for valid values, two grey example rows (ignored on import) and an Instructions sheet.
bulk_step_2_desc_update: Download your existing products for this category and stores. Product ID and Variant ID columns identify each row — never edit them.
bulk_step_3_desc: One row = one variant. Rows sharing the same Product Handle become one product with multiple variants. Every attribute column is required and each variant's combination must be unique. SKU must be unique across the catalogue.
bulk_step_images_desc: Upload images in Products > Media, then use the Copy button there to copy each image's path (products/media/...) into the Variant Image / Gallery columns. Public URLs also work.
bulk_step_pricing_desc: For every store you want to sell in, set Listed = Yes and fill Price (required). Discounted Price must be less than or equal to Price. Leave Listed empty or No to skip that store.
bulk_step_merge_desc: Only the cells you fill are changed. Blank cells, missing stores and variants not present in the file are left untouched — nothing is ever deleted by an update.
bulk_step_upload_desc: The whole file is validated first. If any row has an error, NOTHING is imported — fix the listed rows and upload again.
bulk_step_progress_desc: After validation the import runs in the background with a progress bar. When it finishes you will see how many products were created or updated, plus any rows that failed.
